source.method: Disassembly listings from ghidra-cli 12.1.4 were treated as leads. Every instruction sequence below is confirmed against the pinned bytes by tools/verify_music_song_resources.py --exe.

request.derivation: resource id = 0x07FE0000 + the zero-extended u16 song id, so every u16 value maps into 0x07FE0000..0x07FEFFFF and no id is rejected before the request.

siteRoles.0x004bbb82..0x004bbd58: nine mode branches of the SetMusic control 0x004bbb30
siteRoles.0x007cf362: class test in a resource request path that compares the high 16 bits of an id with 0x07FE

request.boundary: The scan counts the little-endian immediate inside .text. A resource id built another way is not covered.

formatter.pathForm: data/%02X/%02X/%02X/%02X.DAT from the id bytes, most significant first
modeEvidence: The tracked producer page leaves the request-time value of byte 0x01266b64 unproved.
A zero byte selects a table path that needs a table file opened with mode rt, and the installation holds no file outside the numeric data/XX/XX/XX/XX.DAT form.
The one retained live open used the numeric form data\2A\08\00\17.DAT, correlated to a resource id by inference only.
formatter.boundary: The retail launcher or command line may set the byte. Only a live capture of the formatter call can promote the status.

missingFile.openFailure: For one missing path the open returned errno 2, left a null FILE*, called the error helper once and returned false with no retry and no fallback path (xivl-client-structs manifests/resource_dat_open.json, missingDatExperiment, a bounded live observation).

readService.observation: When LocalFile+4 is null the service skips the read and stores state 3 in Resource+0xb0. A successful read stores state 2 instead.
readService.stateMeaning: 2 follows a successful read, 3 follows a cancelled, rejected, unallocated, unopened or short read. These readings are interpretation of the stores.

missingFile.boundary: The reaction is read from instructions in the pinned executable and from the owner installation's file contents. It was not run. The audible result of a bank with no stream and the formatter mode stay open.

policy.receiverInputs: The receiver takes the song id and the mode byte from the packet. No zone, region, combat or time input reaches the derivation (xivl-decomp:docs/net/music-control-runtime.md).
policy.zoneDataColumns: No tracked xivl-client-data mapping carries a music column. The dayMusic, nightMusic and battleMusic columns of xivl-client-data:tools/mappings/zones.py are constant zero server-side columns.
policy.retailSenderSamples: Two combat captures show song 13 mode 1 then song 57 mode 4 (xivl-captures:studies/music-000c-wire). The active zone of those samples is unresolved.
policy.openQuestion: Which song and mode retail sent at zone entry, sub-area boundaries, combat and events.

install.scope: owner installation of build 2012.09.19.0001, existence and size and SHA-256 only

owner.request: receiver slot 4 at 0x00441dc0 when module byte +0x24 is zero, slot 5 at 0x00441f00 otherwise
owner.loadInterface: ResourceModule slot 1 through module +0x04 with nine arguments: the resource id, 0, 0, 1, the SoundCacheSound as callback, then four zeros

outcomes.claim: Slot 4 returns false before it stores anything while the driver global is null.
Slot 4 stores the resource id at slot +0x10 before it looks up or issues the load, so a failed or empty load leaves the id recorded.
The request path releases the selected slot with the request duration before slot 4, so the previous song fades out or stops even when the new load fails.
A request for the id the selected slot already records returns at once, and an id with a map entry only appends a command to that entry, so a failed id is never loaded again.
Resource state 3 publishes state 8 and calls the SoundCacheSound back with success flag 0.
The callback with flag 0 returns false at once, so no sound id is created and the queued start command never runs.

A failed or empty load leaves its entry in the module map with time stamp 0, which the idle reaper skips, so it is not removed or retried. No clear of the map was traced. Song ids 7, 30, 31 and 32 get a sound id and follow the normal stamp and reap path.
The traced slot 4, callback and state dispatch bodies hold no log, message or error-raise call beyond the LocalFile error helper.
A Resource of length 0 makes the callback return false before any buffer is read, in either read outcome, so song id 0 is silent like a missing file.
A buffer that opens with SEDB and SSCF and carries version 3 or less gets a bank object, and bank construction reads no stream count, so song ids 7, 30, 31 and 32 are not rejected at construction.
Whether a started instance of a bank whose table words are 1, 0 and 0 produces any audio, and whether the slot handle stays live, was not traced.
A buffer the driver rejects gives an invalid id, and the callback retries creation up to ten times with a 100 ms sleep each before it gives up silently.
The module byte +0x24 is zero from construction, which selects slot 4. A later store to the byte was not searched.
The Lua wrapper sign-extends a 16-bit song, so a Lua song of 32768 or more gives a resource id below 0x07FE0000 and a path with no file.
The deferred cell holds -1 for no pending song, so mode 4 with Lua song 65535 releases the current song and schedules nothing, while a packet value 65535 is zero-extended and schedules a request.

The bank creator calls the new bank's loader (vtable slot 2) itself before it returns the id and never reads the loader's result, so the loader cannot reject a bank. For song ids 7, 30, 31 and 32 it reads the words 1, 0, 0, walks the one entry word 0 counts and stores 0xff in byte +0xf of entry 0. Where the entry offset lands in the buffer was not traced.

The SoundCacheSound callback returns false on every path including success. It stores ready byte +0x24 as 1 at 0x004433c4 on every path past the length gate, before the bank result is checked, so a bank rejected after the ten retries still sets the byte. Flag 0 and a zero length set no byte.
